name: Telephony (RIL over the Qualcomm modem) - EXPERIMENTAL
description: Replaces Huawei's Balong RIL vendor library with one that talks QMI to the sweet modem over QRTR: SIM card (status, PIN/PUK, file access, IMSI/ICCID), network registration, signal, operator name, network selection and preferred network type, network time, voice calls (dial, answer, reject, hold/swap/conference, DTMF), SMS (send, receive, status reports, SMSC) and mobile data (QMI WDS on the IPA rmnet_data0..3 interfaces that sweet-rproc creates). SIM 2 is reported but not registered. No VoLTE/IMS.
